verdicts.rationale: Both entries are 'The Structure of Bias' by Gabbrielle M Johnson, Mind 129(516):1193-1236, DOI 10.1093/mind/fzaa011. Johnson2020 is a Zotero-style key duplicate of the deepIndexed survivor.

All four are the book 'How We Reason' by Johnson-Laird (OUP). The 2006/2009 years and differing ISBNs are printings/editions of the same book. Only the survivor is deepIndexed; no second member is independently indexed, so the edition rule folds them into the survivor.

verdicts.id: functional anatomy of macaque striate cortex ii retinotopic organization
verdicts.rationale: Both are the same 'Part II. Retinotopic Organization' article by Tootell et al., J Neuroscience 8(5):1531-1568, 1988 (same DOI). Both members are Part II, not I vs II. Only the survivor is deepIndexed.

Both are 'Exploring the Effects of Violating the 180-Degree Rule...' by Kachkovski et al., Communication Research, DOI 10.1177/0093650219838959. Kachkovski2019 is a Zotero-style key with fuller fields; same work.
Identical fields (title, authors, year, journal, volume, number, pages, DOI 10.1093/jos/ffh027). Kanazawa2005 is a Zotero-style duplicate of the deepIndexed survivor.

Despite misleading citekeys (kaplan1977demonstratives, kaplan1989logic, etc.), every member shares the same title 'On transcribing junkie voices', author Kaplan Charles D., booktitle, pages 355-364, and DOI 10.1075/fos.20.27kap. All are shadow/duplicate keys of the one deepIndexed work.
Both are Gisela Kaplan, 'Pointing gesture in a bird...', Current Zoology 57(4):453-467, DOI 10.1093/czoolo/57.4.453. Kaplan2011 is a Zotero-style duplicate.
Identical fields: Kersten & Yuille, 'Bayesian models of object perception', Curr Opin Neurobiol 13(2):150-158, same DOI. Zotero-style duplicate.
Both are Kjorup, 'Pictorial speech acts', Erkenntnis 12(1), DOI 10.1007/bf00209915. pictorialspeechacts1978 is a title-derived duplicate key of the deepIndexed survivor.
Identical fields: Kment, 'Counterfactuals and the Analysis of Necessity', Philosophical Perspectives 20(1):237-302, same DOI. Kment2006 is a Zotero-style duplicate.
Both are Koksvik, 'Conservation of Energy is Relevant to Physicalism', Dialectica 61(4):573-582, DOI 10.1111/j.1746-8361.2007.01124.x. Koksvik2007 is a Zotero-style duplicate.

Survivor kosslyn1980image and kosslyn1980language are the same 1980 Harvard UP book (same ISBN 9780674443655) — merge OK. But member '1996-' is a distinct work: an article 'Image and Mind' in Poetics Today 3(1):198, 1982, DOI 10.2307/1772225 (JSTOR) — a book REVIEW of the Kosslyn book, not the book itself. It is independently indexed (indexed_state 'indexed', has folder), so merging it would archive real work. Exclude it.
